meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以检查当前工作区中代码的错误（诊断）、跳转到定义、查找引用、查看符号列表以及进行重命名安全检查，适用于配置了语言服务器的语言（如 TypeScript 等）。
howto.when: 当你想检查代码错误、查看定义、查找引用、浏览符号或安全重命名时，可以请 Claude 帮忙。通常在你编写或阅读代码时触发。

say.note: Claude 会运行诊断并报告问题。

say.text: 跳转到这个函数的定义
say.note: Claude 会定位并显示函数定义位置。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can check code errors (diagnostics), go to definitions, find references, list symbols, and check rename safety in the current workspace for languages with configured language servers (e.g., TypeScript).
howto.when_en: When you want to check code errors, see a definition, find references, browse symbols, or safely rename, ask Claude. Typically triggered while you edit or read code.

say_en.note: Claude will run diagnostics and report issues.

say_en.text: Go to definition of this function
say_en.note: Claude will locate and show the function definition.
